description: Wafeq accounting API: all 251 endpoints as safety-categorized MCP tools, over stdio or HTTP.
name: io.github.ohneben/wafeq-mcp

environmentVariables.description: Server transport. Set to 'stdio' for local MCP clients; the image otherwise starts the Streamable HTTP transport.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_TRANSPORT

environmentVariables.description: Private organization API key, sent as `Authorization: Api-Key <key>`. Wafeq -> Settings -> Developer -> API keys. Required unless WAFEQ_ACCESS_TOKEN is set.
environmentVariables.name: WAFEQ_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: OAuth2 app access token, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Use instead of WAFEQ_API_KEY.
environmentVariables.name: WAFEQ_ACCESS_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated resource groups to expose, e.g. invoices,bills,reports. Empty exposes all 251 generated tools.
environmentVariables.name: WAFEQ_TOOL_GROUPS

environmentVariables.description: Overrides the Wafeq API base URL. Defaults to https://api.wafeq.com/v1
environmentVariables.name: WAFEQ_API_BASE_URL

environmentVariables.description: Bearer token required on the /mcp endpoint when running the HTTP transport. Empty leaves the endpoint open, so bind it to localhost only.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_SHARED_TOKEN

title: Wafeq
